No curated direct parallels are registered on SuttaCentral, but automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive formulaic text reuse within the Pali tradition and alignments with non-Pali Buddhist literature [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. In the Pali corpus, the text shares 406 matching segments across 30 texts, overwhelmingly corresponding to its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* (138 matches, notably §22.1–28.4), and the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā* (17 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares recurrent biographical descriptions and metrical passages with other *Buddhavaṁsa* chapters, including the *Vipassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 21, longest match §15.1–24.2), the *Tissabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 19), and the *Padumabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 10) [DharmaNexus]. Across languages, DharmaNexus detects machine alignments with Sanskrit narratives in the *Mahāvastu-avadāna*, as well as with Tibetan canonical works including the *Bhadrakalpikasūtra* (D0094), the *Jātakanidāna* (D0032), and the *Lalitavistara* (D0095) [DharmaNexus].
